messages:
Jules K: hi team, new hire here — can view the Notion onboarding templates but not edit. Where do we keep the canonical 'first-week' templates and who do I ping for write access?
Nadia S: welcome Jules :wave: Canonical templates are in Company Home > Docs > Onboarding Templates. We keep PM, Eng, and Ops variants there.
Jules K: I can see the folder but the pages show 'Can view'. There's a grey 'Request edit' button but it routes to admins. Any faster route if I need to update the PM checklist now?
Taylor (IT): Hi Jules — we add people to the "Docs Writers" SSO group for team-editing rights. Shortest path is to request access via our access form: https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access and tag your manager. Once that's approved I flip the Notion group membership.
Jules K: thanks — form submitted (jules.k@example.com). For the PM checklist specifically, can I duplicate and start a draft while access is pending?
Nadia S: yes, duplicate is fine. Click ••• on the page > Duplicate > choose your personal workspace. If you want to preserve subpages use 'Duplicate with subpages'.
Docs Bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist step 4 includes "Confirm Notion edit rights". If you're a new hire, reply with your manager's name to auto-notify reviewers.
Jules K: manager is Nadia S.
Taylor (IT): got the form and manager approve flag, putting you into Docs Writers now. ETA ~15 minutes.
Nadia S: FYI our naming convention is important for perms/search: use the prefix format like "[PM] — First Week Checklist". Please keep versions in page history, don't create new top-level pages.
Jules K: noted. One more Q: are there example templates that show what to include for 1:1s and infra access steps?
Nadia S: yes 12 — open Templates > PM > "New Hire 1 Week (PM)". It has a checklist and a tiny script snippet for access e.g. ```/request-access repo-name``` for the bot we use in #eng.
Jules K: perfect, thanks both. I can edit now — confirmed. Appreciate the quick help!
Taylor (IT): All set, you're in Docs Writers. Ping if anything odd with SSO.
